title: Refresh TermAl README and status docs to show where we are after federation recovery, remote gates and gated control (2026-10-29)
outcome: A reader of TermAl's README and current feature/status docs can see clearly what ships and works now, the active limitations and P0s, and what comes next. That covers federation (hostname endpoints, Windows B and Mac links), remote full gates on satellites, and turn-gated control (ON for the Engram project, OFF for TermAl pending w-3af0aab58d4c). The change is docs-only, accurate to master, and cross-linked.
acceptance: README.md and the relevant docs/features briefs state, accurately against master 92572b94 and the tracker: what works now (federation via hostnames, remote full gates on Windows B and Mac, gated control for the Engram project); the active limitations and open P0-level problems, in plain language without tracker ids; and what is next. New statements are cross-linked both ways with existing briefs.
The change is documentation-only. It has passed an independent review pair with no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and has been handed to the integration owner for landing.
